[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Squares of a Sorted Array** [LC 977 · Squares of a Sorted Array](https://leetcode.com/problems/squares-of-a-sorted-array/){difficulty="Easy"}

Squaring is monotone on magnitude, not on value: $(-9)^2 > 4^2$. A sorted array's squares are *largest at the two ends* (a long negative tail and a positive head) and smallest near zero in the middle. So the sorted result is built by repeatedly taking the **larger** of the two end squares and dropping it at the back of the output — the @sec-tp-p3-a back-fill again, this time with the two "runs" being the array's two ends.

[Solved in full in @sec-tp-p3-b.]{.card-link}

:::
